title: Russian Galette Keto Delight
description: A crispy, savory keto delight featuring a flaky galette crust filled with caramelized potatoes and a hint of Russian spices.
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes into very thin rounds.
In a bowl, mix together sliced potatoes, dried dill weed, salt, and pepper.
Unroll the galette sheet and spread the potato mixture evenly, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the galette up to create a crust, pressing gently to seal.
Drizzle the melted butter over the filling and sprinkle with salt.
Bake the galette for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Cut into wedges and serve with a dollop of sour cream.
Optional: Add a sprinkle of chopped fresh dill for extra flavor.
